'''moogle25 BHBM But Only If He Wants To Come V 1.5''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[moogle25]]
* '''Published:''' 4 October 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS7 BHBM moogle25 DS 2004 5840.txt|Download]] (omits The Emperor (V) (Virtual Set 6), Lando Calrissian (V) (Virtual Set 6), General Veers (V) (Virtual Set 4), Blizzard 1 (V) (Virtual Set 4), Blizzard Scout 1 (V) (Virtual Set 4), Location, Location, Location (V) (Virtual Set 5), Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (Virtual Set 6), Breached Defenses (V) (Virtual Set 4), Security Precautions (V) (Virtual Set 4): not in GEMP)

== Introduction ==

and Endor based BHBM that can drain pretty nicely....

== Notes ==

* Security Precautions (V) dested Virtual Set 7 (legal from 2004-07-19); the strategy runs it alongside the printed Security Precautions.
* Original-era (V) cards also: General Veers (V), Blizzard 1 (V), Blizzard Scout 1 (V), Breached Defenses (V) (Virtual Set 4); Location, Location, Location (V) (Virtual Set 5); The Emperor (V), Lando Calrissian (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (Virtual Set 6).
* Original-era printing corrected: Security Precautions (V) (Virtual Set 7) -> Security Precautions (V) (Virtual Set 4) (an earlier dest had linked the modern virtual card of the same name).

== Strategy ==

ok, before you activate use mob points combo to pull carida into hand..

first turn, activate at least 3 force...use IAO combo to pull a docking bay and deploy it...i usually pull the endor one.

use 2 force and Locationx3 (V) to deploy the back door from reserve, while making this search also make sure that both security precautions(V and non-V) are in reserve. also deploy carida...now, depending on what deck LS is playing, i ditch mob points combo to pull security precautions(only if the right one was in reserve deck)...if he is playing HB then pull non-v but otherwise pull the virtual one and put it down on the back door...

if your opponent gave you 2 force then pull emperor and put him down at the back door, if you deploy palpy then grab a force lightening too but if you did emperor (V) then don't worry about it...if you didn't get enough to deploy the emperor then draw the last one(or two) into hand

second turn...activate at least 8(9 if you got out emperor) force...ok pull your other docking bay with IAO combo, and then use 2 force to deploy another battleground site from reserve....now you are pretty much setup...

all thats left to do is just boost your ground up and go after opponents sites...you should have enough space to hold carida and you can satisfy battle plan...this deck isn't really meant to flip but if you do then get everyone to the DS2 throne room quick :) now i'll explains some of my card choices

i have the walkers in there to either boost my ground on endor or i can go after people on yavin or hoth or any other exterior sites...

i have a maul with stick and p-59 in here as a mini hit sqaud...i also have the tat maul in here to put on his ship and go around probing for HB and doing some nice damage with security precautions...

limited resources is bomb...

overseeing it personally and expand the empire on the dark forest make all my drains +2 where i have imperials...thats pretty nice :)

also i'd have more emperors in here but as i don't own anymore i can't put them in here...

one thing i know i have a problem with is holding down sites...i also would like some help in deciding which imperials to put in so that way i can drain for more faster...

help me make this better by reviewing it...thanx...oh and if you want to help me out but don't want to post a review then post what you think i should do in the RFT thread...
